services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Boulder Mountain Resort is the perfect destination for year-round RV adventures in Revelstoke. We offer level pads suitable for all RV and trailer lengths, with both full-service and power-only site options available. Please select the appropriate site length to accommodate your rig. Full-service sites include free WiFi, septic on site, 15A, 30A, and 50A power options, plus a picnic table and personal firepit.Potable water is available on site from May to October. During winter months, we provide a frost-free hose bib connected to the nearest faucet, allowing you to fill your day tank without needing to move your rig.
